Adds `research/targeted-observation-twin`: UAV targeted observation planned with a forecast-ensemble twin's covariance. Exact real error after twin-gain updates (checked against Monte Carlo), closed-form harm radius for over-correlated twins, amplitude and misplaced-variance misspecification, finite-ensemble harm with localisation, and real-sample repair. Stylised 1-D Gaussian field; builds on RECUV / Autonomous Systems IRT direction (no affiliation implied).
